title: A Breathless Drop in the Bathroom

sentences.text: Hush now... in the bathroom, the machines began to awaken at 03:00, sensing a shift as the air started drying out.
A cold breath swept through the air, dropping the humidity sharply to 41.9 %.
Oh, the silence of the readings... this drop was far below what was expected, which was a range of 49.3 % to 50.0 %.
The delicate spell of dryness lingered on, as the air continued drying out until 05:20.
